study: Frozen OKX Top20 SPIKE 云带 V1.7 signal-time pattern screen for 12H peaks >10R

multi_factor_exploration.note: Seven confirmation-time features are screened independently; results are descriptive hypotheses, not significance or strategy evidence.

method.threshold_freeze: Continuous feature medians use signals confirmed on or before 2024-12-31, independent of outcome; 2025 and 2026 use the unchanged thresholds. stop_pct uses fixed 0.015 and 0.03 tiers.
method.feature_comparison: For each feature, high is strictly above its frozen training median and low is less than or equal; confirmed hit-rate difference is high minus low.
method.outcome: Peak bounds reconcile labels: lower bound >10R establishes a hit (including a censored row); for non-censored rows, upper bound <=10R establishes a miss and upper bound >10R without a lower-bound hit is possible. Possible never counts as a miss. Remaining censored rows are reported separately and excluded from the confirmed n/N and bounded rates.
method.bounded_rate: Lower bound = hits/(hits+misses+possible); upper bound = (hits+possible)/(hits+misses+possible). Censored observations are excluded because their status does not identify the peak outcome.
method.risk_tier: stop_pct groups are fixed at 0.015 and 0.03 as supplied; unrecognized values are reported separately.
method.uncertainty: 95% percentile interval from 1000 week-cluster bootstrap replicates for pooled high-minus-low feature differences; intervals are descriptive, not adjusted for the feature screen.
method.coin_direction_adjustment: Equal-weight mean of within-symbol-by-side high-minus-low differences among strata containing both feature groups; one-sided strata are omitted and counted by the reported strata_n.
method.single_coin_sensitivity: Report the high-minus-low difference after removing each coin in turn.
method.timing: first_gt10_bjt minus confirmed_bjt is summarized for confirmed hits only; peak_time_bjt is descriptive and never a predictor.
method.stop_pct_note: stop_pct is summarized only as fixed 0.015 and 0.03 risk tiers; it is excluded from continuous screening.
method.conditional_null: For each overall feature difference, hit/miss labels are permuted within symbol × side × year strata (1000 replicates), with feature thresholds fixed; possible and censored rows are excluded from label shuffling. The two-sided tail is centered on the empirical permutation mean.

risk_tier_thresholds.assignment: fixed stop_pct tiers; stop_pct is excluded from continuous feature screening

direction_discovery.rule: choose the higher confirmed hit rate through 2024; tie or missing direction means no direction discovered

close_distance_r.threshold_rule: training median through 2024; high means strictly greater, low means less than or equal

all_years_coin_side_year_permutation.note: Two-sided tail is centered on the empirical permutation mean because fixed stratum composition can make the null mean nonzero; no multiplicity correction across screened features.
